chunks.text: The Outpatient Department (OPD) module on the HMIS website is designed for management of outpatient services in healthcare facilities. Here are some key features and functions of the OPD module: � Patient Registration : Allows for the quick and efficient registration of patients, capturing essential demographic and medical history information. � Consultation Records : Enables doctors to document and track patient consultations, diagnosis, and prescribed treatments or medications. � Laboratory and Diagnostic Integration : Order laboratory and diagnostic services to Laboratories and retrieve test results, helping in the timely diagnosis and treatment of patients. � Inventory Integration : Order drugs and items to pharmacy directly from doctor desk current stock details can be viewed by doctor helping to raising indent for drugs form OPD desk. � Reporting and Analytics : Provides tools for generating various reports and analytics, helping Doctors monitor service delivery and identify areas for improvement. � Ordering to other services: Ordering other services in Hospital directly from OPD doctor desk like, Surgeries, Procedures, Services, referral to other departments / Hospitals, etc. These features help improve the efficiency and quality of outpatient care, reduce wait times, and enhance patient satisfaction. Benefits of the OPD Doctor Desk � Improved Efficiency: Streamlines various administrative and clinical tasks, allowing doctors to focus more on patient care. � Enhanced Patient Care: Provides comprehensive patient information at the point of care, supporting better clinical decisions. � Reduced Errors: Minimizes errors associated with manual data entry and paper records. � Patient Satisfaction: Enhances patient satisfaction through timely services, reduced wait times, and better communication. Refresh OPD List Button: Clicking on this button refreshes the list of patients in the OPD list to include any patients who have registered for the current department/unit. Mobile Number: Patient's contact number. Department/Unit: Department or unit where the patient is registered. Rx Button: Clicking on the Rx Button redirects the user to the prescription page. Here, the doctor can record vital signs, complaints, diagnosis, and more. Additionally, the doctor can order investigations, services, drugs, and procedures. After saving the details on this page, a prescription is generated for the patient. 1.15. Vitals Button: Clicking on this button allows the doctor to view and record patient vitals on a dedicated screen. The doctor can save only the vitals if needed. This is also integrated within the Rx page for convenience. Additionally, the same vitals button is available for the OPD Nursing desk, enabling nursing staff to record vitals. Once vitals are saved, they can be viewed by the doctor on the Rx page. The doctor also has the option to edit the vitals on the prescription page. Vitals are permanently recorded only when the doctor saves the prescription page; otherwise, they remain as a draft. 1.16. Skip Button: Clicking on the Skip button changes the patient's status from "waiting" to "skipped" on the OPD Doctor Desk list. This helps manage the queue display system outside the doctor's room. When a patient does not turn up for their appointment as per their turn, the doctor can click this button to exclude the patient's name from the queue system. However, the doctor still has the option to record a prescription for a patient who has been skipped. This ensures the patient is removed from the queue system but can still receive medical attention if needed. 1.17.Print button: The Print button is displayed only for patients who have completed their prescription by the doctor. entities.entityDescription: Outpatient Department A department in healthcare facilities responsible for managing outpatient services.
OPD module A software module on the HMIS website designed for managing outpatient services.
HMIS website The official website of the Health Management Information System used for healthcare service management.
Patient Registration A feature of the OPD module that allows quick and efficient registration of patients with demographic and medical history data.
Consultation Records A function enabling doctors to document and track patient consultations, diagnoses, and prescribed treatments.
Laboratory Integration A feature allowing integration with laboratories to order diagnostic services and retrieve test results.
Diagnostic Integration A function that supports ordering and receiving diagnostic test results within the OPD module.
Inventory Integration A capability that allows doctors to order drugs from the pharmacy and view current stock levels.
Pharmacy A department responsible for dispensing medications, integrated with the OPD module for drug ordering.
Reporting and Analytics A toolset within the OPD module for generating reports and analyzing outpatient service delivery.
Ordering other services A feature allowing OPD doctors to order surgeries, procedures, referrals, and other hospital services directly.
Surgeries Medical operations that can be ordered by OPD doctors through the HMIS system.
Procedures Clinical interventions that can be requested from the OPD desk.
Referral The process of sending patients to other departments or hospitals, supported by the OPD module.
Healthcare facilities Institutions providing medical services, where the OPD module is implemented.
Doctors Medical professionals using the OPD module to manage patient care and services.
Patients Individuals receiving outpatient care through services managed by the OPD module.
Medical history Historical health information of patients captured during registration in the OPD module.
Demographic information Personal details such as name, age, gender, and contact information collected during patient registration.
Test results Results from laboratory and diagnostic tests accessible through the OPD module.
Drugs Medications that can be ordered by doctors via the inventory integration feature.
Items Medical supplies or equipment ordered through the inventory system from the OPD desk.
Stock details Real-time information on available drugs and medical items in the pharmacy.
Indent A formal request raised by the OPD desk for procurement of drugs or supplies.
Service delivery The process of providing outpatient healthcare services monitored through reporting tools.
Administrative tasks Non-clinical duties such as registration and reporting streamlined by the OPD module.
Clinical tasks Medical duties performed by doctors, supported by the OPD module.
Manual data entry Traditional method of inputting data that the OPD module helps minimize.
Paper records Physical documentation of patient information that the system aims to replace.
Wait times Duration patients wait for services, reduced by efficient OPD module operations.
Patient satisfaction Level of patient contentment with care, improved by timely services and communication.
OPD Doctor Desk An interface within the HMIS that enables doctors to manage outpatient services efficiently.
OPD Desk lite page A simplified version or page of the OPD Doctor Desk interface.
Health Management Information System A national or institutional system for managing health service data, of which the OPD module is a part.
Seamless experience Smooth and uninterrupted patient and provider experience facilitated by the OPD module.
Clinical decisions Medical judgments made by doctors supported by comprehensive patient data.
Timely diagnosis Prompt identification of medical conditions enabled by integrated diagnostic services.
Treatment Medical care provided to patients, documented and managed through the OPD module.
Communication Exchange of information between doctors and patients improved by the OPD system.
Efficiency Optimal use of time and resources in outpatient care delivery enhanced by the OPD module.
Quality of care Standard of healthcare provided to outpatients, improved through system support.
Service improvement Enhancement of healthcare delivery processes identified through analytics.
Data entry errors Mistakes in recording patient information minimized by digital systems.
Digital records Electronic documentation of patient data replacing paper-based systems.
Prescribed treatments Therapies or medications recommended by doctors and recorded in consultation records.
Prescribed medications Drugs recommended by doctors during consultations, tracked in the system.
Diagnostic services Tests and imaging services ordered through the OPD module for patient evaluation.
Laboratory services Testing services provided by labs, integrated with the OPD system.
Hospital departments Specialized units within a hospital to which patients can be referred from OPD.
OPD services Outpatient services managed through the OPD module, including consultation, ordering, and reporting.
Outpatient services Services provided to patients who are not admitted to the hospital, aimed at improving quality and ensuring a seamless experience for healthcare providers and patients.
Healthcare provider Medical professionals or institutions delivering outpatient services to patients.
Patient Individual receiving outpatient medical services or teleconsultation.
